extraction_scope: worker-6 final mechanism ontology adjudication from local XML/PDF/OA package evidence

mechanism_claims.claim_text: FP-CATH directly binds LPS in the local MST assay, supporting bacterial envelope biomolecule interaction as one antibacterial mechanism component.
mechanism_claims.quantitative_context: KD 1.31 +/- 0.30 uM for GFP-FP-CATH with LPS
mechanism_claims.limitations: Fusion-protein MST binding evidence supports LPS interaction; it is not by itself a full killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: FP-CATH binds P. donghuensis HYS genomic DNA in a gel-shift assay, supporting nucleic-acid interaction as a second mechanism component.
mechanism_claims.quantitative_context: Peptide:DNA weight ratio 0.31:1 inhibited DNA mobility in the source figure/text.
mechanism_claims.limitations: DNA binding is shown in vitro; downstream intracellular target specificity is not directly resolved.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: FP-CATH damages bacterial cell integrity/morphology in SEM, TEM, and PI-staining assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: FP-CATH against E. coli BL21, P. donghuensis HYS, and MRSA 315838 context
mechanism_claims.quantitative_context: PI-positive staining was reported at about 80% after 10 min for P. donghuensis HYS.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Membrane/cell-integrity evidence is phenotype and imaging based; exact per-cell lesion counts are not tabulated.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: FP-CATH improved C. elegans survival in the P. donghuensis HYS infection model, supporting in vivo protective context rather than a separate molecular target.
mechanism_claims.quantitative_context: 26 h survival reported as 71 +/- 3.6% with 5xMIC FP-CATH.
mechanism_claims.limitations: In vivo survival does not identify a molecular mechanism independently from the LPS/DNA/cell-integrity assays.
